preconditions: Outer uses normal UI to launch the existing app and select the same visible clip; no data reset or account/network change
Pin fresh main PID/birth, boot, package SHA, actual content and timestamps before comparing
Replace RUN_ID and LOCAL_OUTPUT with unique persistent paths; refuse preexisting remote/local output
Every adb command uses explicit serial and a 10-second host timeout; timeouts preserve partial output and are not PASS

steps.purpose: Start a self-expiring 20-second trace; this command changes tracing state and writes only the unique trace file, so outer executes it later, not during this read-only baseline
argv: 'test ! -e /data/misc/perfetto-traces/t23-android-reference-RUN_ID.pftrace && perfetto --background -t 20s -b 16mb -s 32mb -a com.ss.android.article.news -o /data/misc/perfetto-traces/t23-android-reference-RUN_ID.pftrace gfx view audio video sched'
steps.acceptance: Retain actual rc/streams and emitted own perfetto PID; unknown outcome is not rerun blindly.

steps.purpose: Wait locally while normal matching clip plays; take timestamped visual samples separately
Confirm session ended via query; do not stop unrelated sessions
Read produced trace to private persistent local output
Read existing app-scoped bounded logs; substitute fresh matched PID

not_included: No claim trace proves visible motion or sound; outer must correlate real clip and timestamps
No SurfaceFlinger content/layer dump in baseline; optional frame timeline config requires separate exact config review
